artworks.title: Panoramic Views of Vesuvius and Monte Pellegrino
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon cuts through the center, showcasing large mountains in purples and grays. Above, the sky is vast with blue and gray clouds. The sky's brushstrokes are fluid, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is muted, with soft grays, purples, and blues creating a serene atmosphere. Below the horizon, the land is lightly sketched with trees, shrubs, and possible structures or rocks.

artworks.title: Views of Monte Pellegrino
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a landscape. The horizon is visible in the upper half of the composition, dividing the sky and ground. There are sketchy lines indicating clouds on the horizon. The drawing features loose pencil strokes, creating a delicate appearance. The landscape includes shrubs, trees, and distant vegetation. The color palette is grayscale, with various tones created by the pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image depicts a city street with buildings and pedestrians. The composition shows a road with buildings in the background. Some smoke rises from chimneys aligned with the building roofs. The detailed linear style suggests a misty atmosphere, likely created through etching or engraving. The monochrome grey color scheme adds to the somber mood, with reflections hinting at rain. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians with umbrellas are in motion on the street. The buildings on the right show vertical and horizontal lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Environs de Dordrecht
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image depicts a river scene with a sailboat sailing to the right. In the distance, windmills can be seen along the horizon. The etching shows delicate brushstrokes that capture details of clouds and water ripples. The color palette is monochrome with shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: Le Pavillion de Mlle. et une partie du Louvre
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Reinier Nooms, called Zeeman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene from an elevated position. The horizon is in the top third of the image, featuring buildings and a bridge across the river. Close to us are small boats along the riverbank, with figures engaging in various activities. The boats and figures are depicted with detailed line work, typical of etching. On the right, a prominent building with intricate architecture adds depth to the composition. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, emphasizing the contrast between the etched lines and the paper's natural hue. In the distance, there are softer lines and lighter shades suggesting hills and structures receding into the background.

artworks.title: Catafalque
artworks.artist: Johann Andreas Pfeffel I after Giuseppe Galli Bibiena
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural structure with elaborate detailing. The image features a large structure with symmetrical classical columns supporting an ornate upper balcony, crowned with decorative statues and intricate carvings. The structure is divided down the middle, presenting a detailed depiction on one side and a partially unfinished sketch on the other, highlighting the process of architectural drawing. The overall composition is rich with architectural elements such as obelisks and statues, portraying an elaborate and grandiose architectural design.

artworks.title: The Noon Recess
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classroom scene with a woman and a child. The image shows an interior of a classroom where a woman is sitting on a bench next to a child who is reading a book. The woman is leaning on her arm on a desk cluttered with books and school materials. A school bell is on the desk. A map of the United States is on the wall behind the woman. Through two windows, scenes of children playing outdoors can be seen. A blackboard with the alphabet and numbers is visible in the background, along with some books and school supplies on another bench. Wooden floors add to the setting's nostalgic feel.

artworks.title: The Temple of Vesta
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view with a low horizon line. The horizon is marked by a distant mountain range. To the left, an old stone building with rounded arches is perched on a small hill. Below the building is a river or stream. The scene features intricate linear brushstrokes portraying stonework, foliage, and water. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia. Closest to us, two figures on horseback are guiding cattle across the shallow waters. In the background, trees and a mountain range are visible, giving a sense of scale and depth.

artworks.title: Vue d'Aqua Pendente sur la route de Sienne a Rome
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a riverside scene viewed from an elevated position looking slightly downward, capturing both land and water. The horizon is placed relatively high, allowing a clear view of undulating hills and a distant village with structures atop them, including what appears to be a castle or fort. To the left, a winding path leads up a hill towards a cluster of buildings perched near the edge, with several figures making their way along the path. Close to us, on the path, are two women engaged in conversation, while another person nearby walks up the slope. In the water below, there are several small boats with billowing sails and figures tending to them. Behind the boats lies a calm river, bordered by dense trees and low hills. The etching exhibits finely detailed line work that provides texture to the landscape, with the shading skillfully portraying depth and dimension. The overall color palette is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of sepia, which adds a historical and timeless quality to the scene. The sky is lightly etched with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Moonlit Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a horizon at dusk or dawn. The horizon divides the composition, with a focus on the light where the sun meets the water. The light source is centrally positioned, drawing the eye towards it. The landscape includes a waterbody reflecting the light, with tree silhouettes framing the scene on either side. The artwork uses a pointillist technique with stippling brushstrokes creating a textured sky. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and beige, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Abandoned Village
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a riverbank, ancient structures, trees, ruins, foliage, and a calm body of water. The scene is depicted in an etching style with intricate lines and hatching, utilizing a monochromatic color palette of greys and blacks.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 16 x 18 cm (6 5/16 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows architectural elements integrated with natural scenery. On the left side are tall, ribbed columns and intricate stonework of a grand structure. The detailed architecture is depicted with clear lines and hatching. On the right, there is a cityscape with various buildings against a mountainous backdrop. Sparse foliage and trees are depicted with delicate yet defined brushstrokes. The color palette is monochrome, contrasting black ink with light paper, characteristic of etchings.

artworks.title: Au Valromey
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river or stream reflecting the surrounding terrain. The horizon is in the center, where the rugged terrain meets the sky. On the left, there are rock formations and foliage, while the right side features tall trees with bare branches reaching upwards. The texture is detailed with fine lines creating shadows, forms, and intricate details. The color palette is mainly dark lines on a light background, typical of a monochrome etching. The water flows from the foreground towards the distance, leading the eye towards rocky cliffs and trees.

artworks.title: Barque de Pecheurs
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with fishing boats anchored in calm waters. A horizon line is slightly above the midpoint, with buildings and hilly terrain visible. The boats are central, with a person rowing a small boat nearby. The etching lines create texture in the waves and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Incendie dans le port de Bordeaux
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene of ships on a body of water, with smoke and fire obscuring the horizon where the sea meets the sky. Some ships have mast reaching into the sky. The artwork uses dense lines and cross-hatching to create a dramatic sky and a tumultuous scene of flames rising from the vessels. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing tension and movement. In the distance, flames contrast against darkness, creating a sense of depth and drama.

artworks.title: Trompe l'oeil
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows various printed and hand-drawn materials including a map, an architectural drawing, and a manuscript, surrounded by smaller images like military figures, floral still life, and landscapes. The color palette consists of muted tones like light blues, browns, grays, and hints of green and pink. The map is positioned centrally and angled diagonally, with the manuscript above it. The building drawing is on the right, and scenic artwork to the lower right. Drafting tools are on the lower left. The diverse images are arranged over a lined background, resembling items on a work surface.

artworks.title: Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural interior. The drawing depicts an elaborate interior space characterized by high arches, grand columns, and decorative elements such as sculptures and intricate moldings. The structure is symmetrical, leading the eye towards the central feature, which appears to be an elevated platform or altar with a statue or a decorative piece positioned on top. The sketch is lightly rendered with fluid lines, suggesting an airy, open atmosphere within the space. The artist's use of lines hints at rich textures and complex details, evoking a sense of grandeur and elegance typical in monumental architecture.

artworks.title: Fantastic Architectural Studies
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural sketches. The drawing displays three separate sketches, each depicting different architectural elements. In the top left, there is a curved structure with intricate detailing. The top right sketch shows an architectural scene with a series of arches and a staircase. The lower part of the drawing illustrates a rectangular structure that appears to be a hall with multiple arches and columns. The overall composition is executed in pencil with sepia-toned stains on the paper.

artworks.title: Grotesque with a Satyr
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate symmetrical design featuring an ornate vase and grotesque mask. The central decorative motif includes a tall, narrow vase that tapers towards the top, adorned with scrolls and floral patterns. The vase is flanked by curling leaves and flowers that extend upwards and downwards. At the base of the composition is a grotesque figure that merges into the entwined scrollwork. The detailing is executed with fine, flowing lines, typical of ornamental design in period architecture or interior decoration.

artworks.title: Marine View
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with a ship close to us, its masts outlined against the sky. The horizon is low in the composition, with the ship forming a silhouette against the background. The artwork uses etching techniques with intricate details and shading. The color palette is sepia, emphasizing the contrast between the ship and the sky and water. Other boats with sails are visible in the distance on the right side, and trees are on the left.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a low horizon line. Two silhouetted figures are seated on a slight rise to the left. Trees extend from the center to the right, leading towards a distant structure with a dome. The sky has a textured appearance with horizontal etching lines. The trees are depicted with cross-hatching brushstrokes for the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown, offering a timeless quality.

artworks.title: Three Bathers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel

artworks.title: Landscape with Roger Liberating Angelica
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper backed with heavy laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.8 × 44.8 cm (12 1/8 × 17 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image features a sprawling landscape with natural and architectural elements. In the foreground, a reclining nude figure rests beside a tree with intricate leaves. A dragon-like creature is beside her, while a jug emits light smoke nearby. In the background, there are medieval-style buildings, including a circular fortress and a detailed bridge over a river. The structures are set on rocky terrain, with swirling clouds in the sky above. Among the clouds, a mythological figure riding a lion is depicted. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of greyscale, typical of engraved works.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saint Catherine
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within plate): 48.5 x 35.7 cm (19 1/8 x 14 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image features four figures: a woman and child seated at the center, with two adults on either side. The central woman cradles the unclothed child while looking down at them. On her left, another woman reaches out to touch the central woman's arm. On the right, an older man stands behind them, reaching forward. The background includes architectural elements like columns and arches, with greenery and distant buildings visible.
